scope: Research and staff review only. No imports or live changes made by this task. Parent reports 26 published FiveM listings after GTA World; recheck for duplicates before import.

recommended.name: ECLIPSE Roleplay
recommended.description: ECLIPSE Roleplay is an established English-speaking community for structured voice roleplay in Los Santos. Players build ongoing characters through civilian work, businesses, emergency services, government and criminal stories. Founded in 2017, the community moved to FiveM in 2026 and develops its own game systems. New players complete a roleplay quiz and staff review before playing. Its detailed rules cover character conduct, reporting and consent for mature scenes. Read the official joining guide and rules first; the community is still refining the experience after its recent move to FiveM.

sources.purpose: Current homepage explicitly provides FiveM download steps and play.eclipse-rp.net:30120; links y2gxAjg Discord. Registration has a six-step public form; it was viewed without submission.
Official FiveM listing matches original ECLIPSE identity and website. Do not substitute similarly named yjbqg5 or Hungarian z7qzld.
Still-published official onboarding requires a quiz with manually reviewed short answers. Its old RAGE Multiplayer client/address instructions are obsolete; current website gives FiveM connection.
September 5 first-person recommendation corroborates current quiz requirement and updates while noting criminal-system work remains. One player account is limited evidence, not universal endorsement.

English requirement and conduct/reporting rules. Mature scenarios use consent/withdrawal; IC slurs can be permitted under that system and entering certain scenes can imply consent. Do not promise family-friendly or universally comfortable play.
Current players confirm recent FiveM migration, appreciate identity/business roleplay and request improvements to civilian content, housing affordability and migration stability.
September 2026 faction-leadership criticism and founder response provide governance context. Concerns are attributed stakeholder perspectives, not proven abusive conduct.
Fresh aggregate gta5 source with matching website, English locale, count and icon version. Raw public flag must not override stronger reviewed admission evidence.

inclusionReasons: Long-running structured voice-roleplay community with verified new FiveM identity.
Adds substantive civilian, business and government character options with published governing rules.
Fresh observed activity exceeds representative launch criterion without relying on Discord membership.
Working official Discord and actual decoded artwork verified.
Current criticism and mature policies are considered proportionately; inclusion carries truthful caveats.
conflicts: Cfx raw access is public. Use reviewed allowlisted based on official quiz/manual-review guide plus current player corroboration; actual approval was not exercised.
Official onboarding retains obsolete RAGE connection instructions. Use current FiveM website/code, not old address/port.
Post-migration stability, economy affordability and faction leadership expectations receive current public criticism. Do not promise flawless/newcomer-perfect play.
Mature IC conduct policies are more permissive than some shortlist alternatives; accurate context matters.
International is an editorial audience label, not a hosting or latency claim.
No in-game session, private moderation outcome or paid-shop audit was performed. No cosmetic-only or universal friendliness claim is made.
